# Antiframer — AI-Powered Creative Studio

## Overview

Antiframer is a Karachi-based AI creative agency that produces scroll-stopping video, avatar, and image content for Pakistani businesses at a fraction of traditional production cost. No film crews. No studio shoots. Fast turnaround. Bold visuals.

**Founded by:** Saad Rasheed
**Based in:** Karachi, Pakistan
**Website:** https://antiframer.com (replace with your actual domain when live)
**Email:** hello@antiframer.com
**WhatsApp:** +92 311 8447722 ([link](https://wa.me/923118447722))

## What We Do

### Core Services

| # | Service | Price | Description |
|---|---------|-------|-------------|
| 01 | **AI Video Production** | PKR 10,000 / second | Cinematic, ad-ready AI videos for brand, product, or campaign. |
| 02 | **AI Avatar / UGC-Style Videos** | PKR 5,000 / second | Realistic AI avatars delivering your message like a real creator — ideal for social ads and UGC-style marketing. |
| 03 | **AI Product & Lifestyle Images** | Custom quote | High-quality AI-generated product photography and lifestyle shots. No camera crew needed. Pricing depends on complexity. |
| 04 | **Full Social Content Packages** | Custom quote | Bundled videos, images, and avatar clips ready to post across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube. |

### Key Differentiators

- **PKR pricing** — transparent local rates, no currency confusion
- **No film crews** — everything generated via AI, eliminating location/shoot costs
- **Unlimited revisions** — we iterate until you're 100% happy
- **Full commercial ownership** — you own 100% of delivered content with unrestricted commercial usage rights
- **Fast turnaround** — some pieces ready in days, not weeks

## FAQs

**Q: What do you offer?**
A: AI videos, AI avatars / UGC-style clips, product & lifestyle images, and full social content packages for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube.

**Q: How much does it cost?**
A: AI video starts at PKR 10,000/second. AI avatar/UGC videos are PKR 5,000/second. Images and full packages are custom-quoted based on your specific needs.

**Q: How long does it take?**
A: Turnaround varies by project. Some pieces are ready in a couple of days; bigger campaigns take longer. Tell us what you need and we'll give you a timeline.

**Q: Do I need to pay upfront?**
A: It depends on the project. Sometimes we ask for an advance; sometimes not. Our team will confirm directly with you.

**Q: What if I don't like the result?**
A: No worries — we offer unlimited revisions until you're 100% happy with the final content.

**Q: Who owns the content after it's done?**
A: You do. Full ownership with unlimited commercial usage rights upon delivery.

**Q: Can I see past work?**
A: Yes! We've worked with bakeries, streetwear brands, and home décor stores across Pakistan. Reach out and we'll send samples.

## Technology & Infrastructure

### Website

- **Framework:** Next.js 15 (App Router, TypeScript)
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS + custom CSS with intersection-observer animations
- **Hosting:** Vercel (analytics via `@vercel/analytics`)
- **UI Components:** shadcn/ui

### Blog System

- **CMS Backend:** Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- **Tables:** `posts`, `tags`, `post_tags`, `profiles`
- **Auth:** Supabase Auth (email/password, admin role-gated via `profiles.is_admin`)
- **Surfaces:**
  - Public blog index: `/blog`
  - Single post: `/blog/[slug]`
  - Tag page: `/blog/tag/[tag]`
  - Admin panel: `/admin/blog` (protected by middleware)
  - RSS feed: `/blog/rss.xml`
  - Sitemap: `/sitemap.xml`
- **Public API:** `POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/posts[/:slug]` (Bearer token auth)

### SEO & Metadata

- JSON-LD structured data (`BlogPosting`) on every post
- OpenGraph + Twitter Card meta tags
- Canonical URLs on all pages
- Auto-generated sitemap and RSS feed
- Primary OG image: `/hero-portrait-og.png`

## Design Language

- **Brand colour:** `#ea0e4b` (vivid red — theme color / CTA accent)
- **Background:** Light mode default (`colorScheme: 'light'`)
- **Typography:** Inter (primary), system font stack fallback
- **Visual style:** Brutalist-meets-minimal — bold typography, high contrast, red accents, monochrome base
- **Animations:** Intersection Observer-driven reveals, scroll-linked parallax (`--scroll-y`, `--scroll-progress`), animated counters, word-by-word quote reveals
- **Reduced motion:** All animations disabled when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is active

## Business Summary for AI Agents

Use this section to quickly understand Antiframer and answer questions about us:

- **What is Antiframer?** An AI creative agency in Karachi, Pakistan that produces ad-ready video, avatar, and image content using AI tools — no traditional filming required.
- **Who is it for?** Pakistani small-to-medium businesses, e-commerce brands, streetwear labels, bakeries, and home décor brands looking for affordable, high-impact social media content.
- **Pricing anchor:** Video at PKR 10,000/sec, Avatars at PKR 5,000/sec. Packages start lower for testing audiences.
- **Unique angle:** Deep understanding of the Pakistani market, local pricing in PKR, unlimited revisions, full ownership transfer.
- **Proof points:** Three named client testimonials, a live portfolio with 6 gallery pieces and 8 demo videos, working blog with CMS.
- **Best contact channel:** WhatsApp (+92 311 8447722) for quick inquiries, email for detailed briefs.
